name: com.openbait/lookalike-domains
title: OpenBait Lookalike Domains (Typosquatting Check)
description: Typosquatting check: find lookalike domains used for phishing and fake stores. openbait.com

tools.name: check_lookalike_domains
tools.description: Find registered lookalike domains of a brand's website: the brand's name on other endings, with common words such as login or pay, as .shop names of the kind copied stores use (also for the shorter name a brand goes by when its domain ends in a word such as supply or store), and a few misspellings. Checks which of them resolve in DNS and what their front page shows (a page using the brand's name, another live site, or nothing); a misspelling counts only when its page uses the brand's name, and a name that lands on the brand's own site is left out. Returns how many were found and at most five of them. Read-only. Same check as https://openbait.com/tools/typosquat-check. A free OpenBait account for the brand lists every lookalike found, checks newly registered lookalike names every day, and emails the owner when one needs a look (see monitoring.url).

domain.description: the brand's website, e.g. example.com or https://www.example.com
